title: Vera explains a Space's settings to the people who run it, from inside that Space, and says where to change each one

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-11-03 16:38Z (an Admin and Web Assistant that answers any question about functions and settings) and 20:39Z (I approve everything, get this done); Vera assistants plan /mnt/project-files/vera-assistants-2026-11-03/REPORT.md, phase V0 (settings registry, explain mode for Space owners).

detail:
Vera in the member chat knew nothing about the Space a person runs, so "where do I set my booking hours?" got a guess. When someone who can edit a Space asks from inside it, the page sends the Space slug, the turn resolves the caller's own role through getSpaceCapabilities, and her prompt carries that Space's settings derived from the Space module catalog (SPACE_MODULES through the manifest, so it cannot drift from the menu): each area with what it does and where it lives, the areas turned off and where to turn them on. Explain only: she says she cannot change a setting from chat and points to the place; money, the plan and deleting are named as the owner's. A plain member or a visitor gets nothing extra.

Shipped: lib/ai/vera/space-guide.ts, the optional space slug on the turn body, the guide in the volatile prompt half, tests and probe.
